01CE189938484D272713A655D7A44EF8: The Irish rapper and producer Kojaque grew up in Dublin and creates distinctive hip-hop that blends jazz, soul and personal stories. With his debut album Town’s Dead (2021) and its follow-up PHANTOM OF THE AFTERS (2023), he has built a solid reputation within the alternative hip-hop scene. His music strikes a balance between sharp social commentary, humour and introspection, drawing on influences from both American hip-hop and the Irish music scene.
0919594B665933283FC15E30A73DA791: The British punk duo The Meffs deliver a mix of heavy guitars, catchy riffs and socially critical lyrics. Since their breakthrough in 2019, they have become one of the most exciting live bands on the British punk scene. With their outspoken messages about equality and social inequality, they love to challenge the status quo. Their first EPs, Broken Britain Part 1 & 2, were produced by Frank Turner and released on the label run by NOFX frontman Fat Mike. Following their debut album What A Life (2024), the follow-up Business was released in September 2026 – an album brimming with furious punk rock and sharp criticism of modern society. With appearances at Glastonbury and Download, and support slots for acts including the Sex Pistols and NOFX, The Meffs have proven that two musicians are more than enough to completely turn a venue upside down. Expect punk rock as it should be: loud, sharp and no-nonsense! ﻿
0FA636ADA067DD54CC75C8B0B8AB8505: So long, English! Meltheads starts a new chapter and returns to Dutch to do so. Not twelve times Naïef , yet still thoroughly Meltheads. Sietse Willems , Yunas De Proost , Tim Pensaert and Simon de Geus had already established a solid live reputation when they broke through to a broader audience in 2022 with the instant Belpop-classic Naïef . Two years later, they burst onto the scene with their debut album Decent Sex , a fierce, relentless and unadulterated fever dream lasting around 30 minutes. National and international media – including BBC Radio 1, KEXP and Clash Magazine – fell head over heels for their sultry mix of post-punk, noise, psych and rock-’n-roll. Prominent appearances at renowned showcase and rock festivals ensued. Shows in Belgium and The Netherlands sold out and as support-act to dEUS they toured parts of Europa. Meltheads live is an experience. Now they’re going to do it all again, but this time in Dutch. The first step in this change of direction took place earlier this year, with a cover of En Toen Was Er Niets Meer by De Brassers for the film Dust by Anke Blondé . The door to Dutch was opened and never closed again. “Dutch inspires me again”, says frontman Sietse Willems. “At some point I started writing in it again. I sought a new way of writing and this is what happened, what can I say? But don’t expect twelve versions of Naïef .” He couldn’t have made a better choice. So Chapter 2 won’t be a trip down memory lane.
15ADF5B05AD7E516C7CCB64429F9C127: Cult of Luna , the Swedish post-metal band from Umeå, have been known for 25 years for their leaden, experimental sound that combines hardcore, sludge, folk and art rock. On their tenth album, In the Shadow of Your Shadow , the band once again delves into dark and intense themes such as loss, depression, anger and mortality, without lapsing into musical repetition. Guest contributions by the likes of Gojira -frontman Joe Duplantier and folk icon David Eugene Edwards lend the album extra character. Tracks like Burial and Sadness Will Reign once again demonstrate why Cult of Luna ranks among the best post-metal bands.

NTO has been one of the leading names in French melodic techno for many years. With performances at festivals and venues such as Tomorrowland, Printworks, Sónar, Dour, Fusion and Sziget, he has built a strong international reputation. With his critically acclaimed debut album APNEA and collaborations with artists such as Paul Kalkbrenner, French79, Meute, Vitalic, Röyksopp and Monolink, NTO continues to push boundaries. In 2024, he surprised us once again with Forever Friends, a remarkable album he created in collaboration with pianist Sofiane Pamart.

Expect a captivating live set from an artist who has been winning over audiences worldwide for almost a decade.
2EF3DD2C63D4523CA651463049EC6A92: Carpenter Brut blends electronic music, metal and 1980s pop culture into a unique, dark and energetic world of his own. Since 2015, he has established himself as one of the leading artists on the international synthwave scene, with a powerful and direct sound. Drawing inspiration from the likes of John Carpenter, Dario Argento, Slayer and Justice, Carpenter Brut has built a coherent, dark and stylised world, at the crossroads of retro thriller, glam metal and futuristic dystopia. With Leather Temple, he brings to a close a trilogy begun with Leather Teeth (2018) and Leather Terror (2022), delivering a complete work: at once a concept album, the soundtrack to an imaginary film and a post-apocalyptic visual experience.
3D9FD372145186025C7D21E2D90EFF6D: Two bands, one frontman and a whole lot of healthy chaos on stage! The American hardcore band The Bronx have been delivering energetic live shows for over twenty years, but they also have a surprising musical alter ego in the form of Mariachi El Bronx . In this project, they swap heavy hardcore riffs for trumpets, violins and traditional Mexican mariachi. With their ‘Super Show!’ , both worlds merge into a single, unique live show in which, backed by a nine-piece band, they effortlessly switch between raw punk and danceable, upbeat mariachi. Two completely different genres, but one huge party!
406AE5FEBBE484729BCAB74EC6980DF5:
Getdown Services from Bristol are a duo comprising childhood friends Josh Law and Ben Sadler, who deliver a slightly absurd mix of disco, funk, post-punk, rock and spoken word. Dry British humour, down-to-earth observations of life and socially critical themes are central to their work. Live, they are known for their chaotic, anarchic and extremely energetic shows, which have seen them quickly rise to become one of the most striking new British live bands.

With their new album Massive Champion, released in August ’26, they build on their recognisable sound, whilst also sounding more personal and emotional, without losing their absurdist edge.
406FCF0EFF9BA635A1E0C7C130D8343B: A Date with Depeche Mode is Nouvelle Vague’s new album, recorded between Rio de Janeiro and Paris, bringing together eleven international singers around the catalogue of Depeche Mode. Nouvelle Vague at their best

The concept’s formula?

Early on the dance floor. New music. All for a good cause.

Following sold-out events at KMSKA and Traum in Antwerp, Keinevision is heading to AB in Brussels for the first time.

Diblecua Mirrar will be taking the evening entirely in his own hands. All evening long 5h set: 17h30 – 22h30. A long set full of melodic tension, deep grooves and hypnotic club music. No rush, no set route — space to let the evening evolve organically.

This time, all proceeds will go to AB’s solidarity contribution fund. Since early 2022, AB has been offering Solidarity Tickets : free or discounted tickets intended for people experiencing poverty or social vulnerability. As part of this initiative, a network of around twenty Brussels-based social organisations has been developed. These organisations rely on the Solidarity Tickets programme to organise outings and cultural experiences for their communities. At AB, we believe that culture is a fundamental right. Our aim is therefore to further expand this programme and open even more doors for those who need it.

This session will take place at GC Everna, Rue St Vincent 30, 1140 Evere. Doors open at 09:30 and we’ll start singing at 10:00. The session is scheduled to finish at 11:30.

Do you want to improve your Dutch and do you enjoy singing? Then you’ve come to the right place! Every month, accompanied by two musicians and a set list full of Dutch-language classics, we head to a different community centre in Brussels. There, we practise Dutch together.... through singing!

Through Dutch-language songs, you’ll get to know the language better in a fun and accessible way. At the same time, you’ll discover more about Belgian culture and meet new people. Three birds with one stone!

And don’t worry: you don’t need to be Ann Christy or Clouseau. Fun and enthusiasm are what matter most. You don’t need to be a talented singer!

We’ll provide a pianist, a lead singer, the song lyrics and a free drink. Everyone is welcome and the sessions are free . Registration is required, though.

Take a look at our schedule and find out when we’ll be singing near you. Fancy warming up your vocal cords in the meantime? Check out this season’s setlist here !

In collaboration with the Taalunie , Theater van A tot Z and the Flemish Community Commission (VGC).
6E7C638F5D929C4C7F11E6C0A6B0092D: Medium Build is the alter ego of American singer-songwriter Nick Carpenter. With his sharp lyrics, disarming honesty and energetic live shows, he has built up a loyal fanbase over the past few years. His music lies somewhere between indie, lo-fi, country and rock, with influences ranging from Pedro the Lion and Alvvays to Harry Styles and Sam Fender. Following his breakthrough album Country (2024), Medium Build is back with King of Having Fun, his most exuberant and self-assured record to date. The songs were recorded live with his band and combine a fresh rock ’n’ roll energy with the introspective lyrics that characterise Carpenter’s work. The result is an album about learning to enjoy life, love and, above all, yourself all over again.
7749777BEC3A03F94289BC6CEA86BE79: Roosbeef is the band led by singer and writer Roos Rebergen . Since their breakthrough, the band has developed as one of the most distinctive voices in Dutch-language music. Given the wealth of outstanding Dutch-speaking female talent with which we are blessed, it would be easy to forget that Rebergen is a pioneer. She is regarded as one of the most influential lyricists of her generation. Her songs are simultaneously playful, subversive, moving and relatable. Five albums on, Roosbeef has earned a loyal following in The Netherlands & Belgium and garnered praise from press, fellow musicians and listeners. In 2024, Roos released an album featuring classical arrangements of her songs with the SunSunSun Orchestra string quartet. The album and the sold-out concerts received rave reviews. Meanwhile, she has been working on new material. That process was overshadowed by the death of band member and friend Tom Pintens and a period in which Rebergen took a step back to focus on her mental health. Now, Roosbeef announces a sixth studio album in the form of Binnensmonds and De Leugen . And so Roosbeef continues to reinvent itself without ever losing its unique voice.
78863208E216DF38B761C5ED11B028B5: A pioneering group in French rap, Sniper was formed in 1997 in the Val-d’Oise, centred around Aketo, Tunisiano, Blacko and DJ Boudj. They quickly made their mark on the music scene with powerful albums such as Du rire aux larmes (2001), Gravé dans la roche (2003) and Trait pour trait (2006), blending social commitment, urban experiences, social criticism and poetic power. For 2026, Aketo and Tunisiano have announced their return to the stage for a concert tour, under the name Sniper (duo version). A confident return to their roots: reviving the classics, offering new songs, and reaffirming their voice in socially conscious rap. Fans can expect encores of iconic tracks, but also the discovery of a more mature world, free from past tensions, centred on respect, authenticity and energy.

This is a Liveurope concert, the first European initiative that supports concert venues in promoting emerging musical talent from Europe.

Muireann Bradley is a once-in-a-generation talent. The 19-year-old Irish guitarist and singer has captivated audiences worldwide with her ntricate fingerstyle playing and interpretations of classic blues, bringing remarkable warmth, clarity and emotional depth to a centuries-spanning radition. Raised in County Donegal, she began playing guitar aged nine inspired by her blues-loving father, and developed her craft largely by ear, immersing herself in the music of pioneers like Blind Blake, Mississippi John Hurt and Memphis Minnie . Her acclaimed debut album, I Kept These Old Blues , recorded when she was just 14, became a coveted collector’s item, with its first pressing selling out everywhere. Since then, Bradley has taken her spellbinding performances from YouTube to sold-out headline shows on both sides of the Atlantic, earning recognition from industry legends including Jools Holland , who invited her to perform on the Hootenanny. Now, with her Blackwood Pew EP, Muireann has entered an exciting new chapter, stepping forward as a songwriter in her own right. Blending original compositions with fresh interpretations of the music that shaped her, she draws on a lifetime immersed in blues, ragtime, country and Irish traditional music to explore new sounds and stories of her own.

Around 2015, Makala , alongside Slimka and Di-Meh , was part of the Superwak Clique , a collective of French-speaking rappers in Geneva. Together and individually, they built successful careers. Following his last concert in Brussels at a sold-out Orangerie in 2023, Makala made a comeback earlier this year with the EP YAMOTO. A new album is due out in January 2027, which he will be presenting exclusively at AB.

Makala is known as a natural performer who effortlessly draws the audience into his world every time. His live performances stand out for their intensity and precision. Every performance is more than just a show, it is a unique moment in time. Makala is ready.

The question is: are you ready?
A2750F379422E4D4B66D23D0C66CFFDC: Helena Casella is a Belgian-Brazilian composer and singer who grew up in a very musical family. In her music, she explores and incorporates various genres such as R&B, neo-soul, hip-hop, modern jazz and Brazilian rhythms. This is her way of giving expression to her thoughts and daydreams. In her music, Helena emphasises organic live instruments with as few digital effects as possible. Whether performing solo or with a seven-piece band, Helena takes you along in a journey that balances between the world of the intimate and the ethereal. Her debut album Pit Of Impressions was released in early March 2025 on Belgium’s W.E.R.F. Records. Her second album is due in February 2027. This concert forms a part of ABVolta, a residency programme in which Volta residents receive made-to-measure support from Ancienne Belgique. Volta has quickly become an indispensable organisation for the development of young musical talent in Brussels’ music scene. AB and Volta join forces to provide artists with long-term support to help them progress as effectively as possible.
ABE6E8501043158B8FD9219EBF695833:
Over the past two decades, Copenhagen-based composer, producer and musician Anders Trentemøller has established himself as one of the most distinctive voices in contemporary music. Never one to stand still, Trentemøller’s music moves freely between post-rock, electronica, shoegaze, dark wave and alternative rock , always driven by melody, atmosphere and emotional depth . ﻿

His forthcoming album, out 13 November 2026, marks another bold evolution. Across ten songs, it embraces bigger contrasts than ever before “the noisy gets noisier, the dreamy grows dreamier, and the melodies become even more immediate” as Trentemøller puts it. Written, produced, performed and mixed by Trentemøller himself, the new album balances crushing walls of guitar noise with intimate, bittersweet songwriting, while retaining the meticulous production and cinematic storytelling that have defined his work since The Last Resort.

On stage, these songs come to life with Trentemøller's acclaimed live band featuring Emma Acs (vocals/synths), Silas Tinglef (drums), Brian Batz (guitar), Jacob Haubjerg (bass/guitar) and Anders Trentemøller (synths). Their performances transform the studio recordings into dynamic audiovisual experiences that seamlessly shift between delicate intimacy and overwhelming sonic climaxes.
AD266EBC025773839569352C36FB6BD4:
Typhee is one of the most striking new voices to emerge from Marseille. The 23-year-old rapper from Beausoleil made his definitive breakthrough in 2026 as the winner of season 5 of Nouvelle École on Netflix, becoming the first artist from Marseille to win the prestigious rap competition. His victory cemented his status as a rising star on the French rap scene.

With his distinctive blend of sunny melodies, raw honesty and melancholic street stories, Typhee offers a fresh perspective on contemporary Marseille. His lyrics explore life in the neighbourhood, doubts, ambition and love, always delivered with striking authenticity.

After an intense year full of releases and collaborations, he consolidated his artistic growth on the EP T.Y., after which his career really took off. Typhee represents a new generation of Marseille rap: personal, melodic and unmistakably southern.
B0CEDDCDA5D27BDA28B2F9CD4FCCED05: Brussels-based songwriter and producer Edouard van Praet combines indie rock, electronic textures and quirky tales in tracks that balance dancefloor energy with emotional ambiguity. The Sound Track 2025 finalist already has two EPs, a debut album and numerous shows in Belgium, Europe and Canada to his name. New single Good Times announces his second album, due out in March 2027. The track sounds restless and addictive, driven by a steady tempo of 152 BPM. Electronic textures are encrusted with the raw edge of rock. Good Times draws on the urgency of 2000s indie rock and the euphoric drive of synthesizer driven indie dance. This new album further explores the interplay between love and hate, longing and rejection, and the growing pains of having to look ahead without entirely being able to leave the past behind. On stage, backed by the band, this tension takes on a tangible, physical dimension. Behind the nonchalant elegance and catchy melodies lie chaos, theatrics and the typical abandon of 'well-mannered punks'.
B3073853314651B336C2FA44CE4165A8: For almost fifty years, Saxon have been flying the flag for British heavy metal. As one of the founding acts of the New Wave of British Heavy Metal (NWOBHM), Biff Byford and co, alongside greats such as Iron Maiden and Judas Priest, emerged in the late 1970s as true pioneers of the genre. With classics such as ‘Wheels of Steel’, ‘Denim and Leather’, ‘Princess of the Night’ and ‘747 (Strangers in the Night)’, they helped write the history of heavy metal. After many years, they’re returning to AB with their ‘Gods of Thunder Tour’ – and they’re not doing so just for the sake of it; we’re one of the only venues to be treated to the full ‘Castles and Eagles’ production. We can’t wait!

BUNT. means ‘colourful’ in German, and that is exactly what this German DJ and producer delivers: a catchy mix of beats, warm melodies and euphoric dance music. He made his global breakthrough with his viral hit ‘Clouds’, which has racked up over 500 million streams. Since then, things have moved at lightning speed: from parcel delivery driver with a musical dream to performances at Coachella, Tomorrowland and Lollapalooza. With his long-awaited debut album ‘LEVI DID IT’, on which he collaborates with artists including The Chainsmokers, Tom Odell and The Temper Trap, BUNT. continues his impressive rise to fame.

At AB, he’ll be presenting his unique ‘IN THE ROUND’ concept, where he spins right in the middle of the audience. Not a traditional DJ set, but one huge, exuberant dance party where artist and audience become one.

Crowned the heir to the French Touch and dubbed by Jean-Michel Jarre himself, Simon Henner (French 79), has established himself as an essential pillar of the global electronic music scene. In the space of three foundational albums ( Olympic , Joshua , and TEENAGERS ), the Marseille-based producer has shaped a singular, immersive, and viscerally unifying musical universe. If his music reaches far beyond the boundaries of the techno sphere, it is thanks to its synesthetic power: his harmonic sequences and arpeggios transform sounds into emotional landscapes, creating a universal connection with his audience.

Today, the impact of French 79 is reflected in staggering numbers. He gathers a community of 770,000 fans and accumulates over 1.7 million monthly listeners on Spotify. His first three albums have generated more than 150 million streams , driven by music videos that exceed 50 million views . He continues to rack up prestigious certifications, with two export platinum singles ( Diamond Veins and Lovin' Feeling ), not to mention the resounding diamond single Moon, produced and co-composed for Kid Francescoli .

On stage, the triumph is absolute: his last tour thrilled 180,000 spectators across 106 dates in 23 countries , with a string of sold-out shows from Paris to Los Angeles.
DB60078E3F35870E3A3AA38E3B8E6676: As a producer and member of Bazart, Oliver Symons has been a fixture on the Belgian music scene for years. Under his own name, the Antwerp native – who often resides in L.A. – opts for a more personal and intimate sound, centred around melancholic songs, layered productions and his distinctive voice. Following a sold-out show at the AB Club, a European tour with Warhaus and a strong performance at Pukkelpop, his second EP, ‘EP2 – Looper’, is due for release on 20 November. Earlier this year, the title track became a radio hit on Studio Brussel. Meanwhile, Symons has signed to the American label Maison Arts and has collaborated with producers behind artists including James Blake, SZA and Lana Del Rey.
E09F7D9EB7D197A460218413228A6762: GRAVEYARD and BLUES PILLS are set to tour Europe and the UK together in March 2027 as co-headliners. With SPIDERS joining them as the support act, it’s set to be a Swedish triple bill to be reckoned with. Get ready for an evening full of bluesy riffs and captivating psychedelia. GRAVEYARD will also be releasing their new album, Fever, which is due out in October 2026. ﻿
E7D653E01335ADFD8FC836C5DAA86D40: Aili & Orson is a Belgian-Japanese electro-pop duo who have made a name for themselves in recent years, nationally and internationally. Formed in the Belgian alternative club scene and rooted in the nuances of Japanese culture, the duo seamlessly bridges two different worlds. The result is a minimalist and colourful universe in which language barriers dissolve into pure, infectious energy. The duo is now preparing for their next chapter, a second album planned for release in the spring of 2027. After a chance encounter in 2019, their musical chemistry led to a playful and spontaneous approach to songwriting that blends electronic beats, samples and Aili’s unique Japanese vocals. Their debut EP Dansu (2021) spent no less than eight weeks at No.1 on the Radio 1 VOX Chart, earned them a nomination for Studio Brussel’s De Nieuwe Lichting, and grabbed the attention of Tokyo-based label TOKA, which then led to the release of a special Japanese edition of the EP. In 2024, they released their debut album Nandakke? via Eskimo Recordings, an album that combined surreal electro-pop with personal stories about Japanese culture. The album catapulted them onto the international stage: they went straight to No.1 in KCRW’s Top 30 Album Chart in the US, received daily airplay on KEXP, BBC Radio 6 Music and Nova France, and landed in major playlists like Metropolis and Pollen, reaching millions of followers.

For over a decade, Acid Arab has been one of the most distinctive names in French electronic music. Emerging from the Parisian club scene, the collective has developed a unique sound that blends electronic beats with vocals, melodies and rhythms from the Arab world, the Middle East, North Africa and the Mediterranean region. In 2026, Acid Arab further expands their artistic universe with a soundtrack for the Hassan Hajjaj exhibition at the Philharmonie de Paris. A project that once again underscores their fascination with the dialogue between music, images and popular culture, signalling a new phase involving international collaborations.

Acid Arab opens a new chapter with their album Resonance . The album remains true to their signature blend of dance, trance and cultural cross-pollination, but also explores a more contemporary and layered form of songwriting. Thanks to new collaborations and a fresh approach to the production process, the band sounds both familiar and innovative.
EF310D45586F4CDD8BFE48C8CE7DA294:
Eivør , one of the most distinctive voices on the Nordic music scene, returns with a new album. Deeply influenced by the rugged landscapes and communal singing culture of her homeland, the Faroe Islands, she blends centuries-old traditions with a contemporary sound. With her new work, she once again moves between different genres, blending Nordic folk, cinematic compositions and modern production into a dark, atmospheric and emotionally charged sound.

You may recognise her voice from The Last Kingdom (TV series) and God of War (game), where she helped shape the immersive sound worlds. Live, Eivør is known for her intense and emotional performances, in which she brings her music to life with an energy that is both intimate and powerful. Her next release marks the beginning of a new chapter: more direct and focused, yet still rich in the emotional depth that characterises her sound.

Eivør will be joined by Rabbitology as a special guest.

Rabbitology is the world created by the idiosyncratic mind of Nat Timmerman, a place full of whimsical ideas and underground twists. Simply follow the tracks of the three-legged rabbit and before you know it, you’ll be knee-deep in a universe of eclectic soundscapes. There you’ll discover a collection of memories transformed into imaginative, musical short stories.
F36A1E6267D4BE1A1AAFAAC82F198628: TeddyBear is a 24-year-old artist from Mons, who grew up in a Sicilian family of musicians and learnt to play the drums alongside his father. Following a number of personal losses, he began to channel his doubts, fears and observations into songs, until an unexpected live performance in 2023 finally brought him behind the microphone. Since then, he has opened for artists including Orelsan, Clara Luciani, Feu! Chatterton and Julien Doré. On his debut album Le plus beau, he blends chanson, pop, rap, jazz and electronica, drawing on influences from Jacques Brel, Yussef Dayes, Alpha Wann and Salvatore Adamo. TeddyBear refuses to be pigeonholed and opts for honest, vulnerable songs about love, family, fear and everything it means to be young today.
FA2B8B7E4ED6E9E83BCF789196073819: After a sold-out first part of the tour, Hatik is back in Brussels for an exceptional date on January 28, 2026 at Ancienne Belgique.
